outcome: mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery, cesarean section, instrumental delivery)
cohort: Grandmultiparous women who delivered at Aminu Kano Teaching Hospital between January 2012 and December 2021.
finding: Grandmultiparity is prevalent among parturients in tertiary hospitals and is associated with various maternal and neonatal complications, underscoring the need for vigilant antenatal care.
